tldr: Lilith in Aquarius: the wound around belonging; the rebel who cannot stop rebelling.
body: With Lilith in Aquarius, being cast out becomes the identity. Contradiction and shock keep others at distance, freedom is defended before it is threatened, and the work that matters happens alone, behind the scenes, where nobody can interfere or reject it.
gift: Original vision, true independence, and the ability to change what everyone else accepted.
challenge: Rebellion for its own sake, unpredictability that isolates, saying one thing and doing another.
note: Distilled from the Black Moon Lilith compilation (Resources/937057437-Lillith-Black-Moon.docx), 'Black Moon Lilith in the Signs' long-form chapter. Lilith reads as a wound-point: shame and rejection processed through the sign's style. Owner-reviewed for live use, 2026-07-28.
